Chapter 16

Chapter 16: Speed and Passion; Arriving at the Hospital

After Lin Fan hung up, he was not in the mood to eat. He went straight to the underground parking lot.

As the engine roared, the Lamborghini dashed out like a wild beast.

In the past, when he was driving, Lin Fan would always maintain a constant speed and drive slowly.

The way he was driving did not seem like he was driving a supercar at all but an ordinary car.

However, today, Lin Fan was not as gentle.

He was nearly drilling through the air and continuously accelerating.

It caused a deep rumble to ring out on the streets from time to time.

When Lin Fan got on the highway, he was like a fish in the water and was without any restraints.

He continued to accelerate!

With his Professional Driving Skills and the support of Absolute Focus, he was able to reach the maximum speed.

Lin Fan wanted to rush to his parents’ side in the shortest time possible.

…

A beautiful woman in a blue dress was driving a red Ferrari on the highway.

At this moment, she suddenly heard the roar of an engine in the distance.

Through the rearview mirror, the beauty in the blue dress saw a silver-gray Lamborghini closing in on her.

Her gem-like eyes immediately lit up, and her thin, willow-leaf-like lips curled up slightly.

Immediately after, her fair, beautiful legs stepped on the accelerator.

Boom!

Instantly, the fiery red Ferrari let out a beast-like roar and accelerated.

A race began.

One could not judge a book by its cover, and the sea could not be measured.

Although the blue-dressed beauty looked quiet, no one would have thought that she had a heart as hot as the sun and driving skills that challenged the limits of speed.

However, it was a pity that she met Lin Fan today.

No matter how fast the lady in the blue dress sped up, Lin Fan was able to close the distance between them bit by bit.

In the end, Lin Fan made a turn and swept past the beauty in the blue dress with a strong gust of wind.

The beauty in the blue dress caught a glimpse of Lin Fan’s figure through the window.

Then, she could only see the tail lights of the car that was speeding away.

“ALF 666, I hope to meet you again soon,” the beauty in the blue dress said softly.

…

Lin Fan did not take the race earlier to heart.

He continued to move forward at his fastest speed.

Jiangbei was not far from Qing City.

Not long after, he arrived at the Central Hospital of Qing City.

He pushed open the door to the ward and saw his father, Lin Tao, lying on the bed. He was breathing with the aid of an oxygen mask with difficulty. His wrinkled face was pale.

Lin Fan’s heart was in pain.

Creak! Creak!

At this moment, the door of the ward opened.

His mother, Dai Weixue, walked in.

“Lil’ Fan, you’re back so soon?” Dai Weixue was shocked.

Lin Fan made a shushing gesture, indicating for them to go out and talk so as not to disturb his father’s rest.

In the corridor.

“Mom, how’s Dad’s condition?” Lin Fan asked.

At the start, Dai Weixue hid it from Lin Fan because she did not want him to worry.

Now that Lin Fan knew that Lin Tao had fallen ill, there was no need to hide it anymore.

“There’s a tumor in your father’s stomach. After we pay the fees, we should be able to arrange for the surgery within these two days.” Dai Weixue’s eyes were slightly red as she said this.

“By the way, you still haven’t told me what that five million is all about?”

When Lin Tao fell ill, Dai Weixue felt as if the entire sky was falling down, but she gritted her teeth and endured it all.

For the past two days, she had been taking care of Lin Tao and borrowing money from people everywhere.

However, the surgery required a huge sum of money, and Dai Weixue couldn’t raise enough in such a short time.

Today, Lin Fan suddenly sent over 5 million bucks, making Dai Weixue both surprised and happy. However, she did not dare to pay the surgery fees immediately.

Lin Fan was just an ordinary worker. Where did he get such a large sum of money?

Dai Weixue was worried that he was taking the wrong path.

If she were to use this sum of money and it ended up harming Lin Fan, then it would be too late for regrets.

Lin Fan said, “Mom, don’t worry. This is the money I earned from investing in stocks and buying Bitcoin. Moreover, this is only a small part of it. Our family is no longer short of money.”

Regarding the system, Lin Fan did not intend to tell anyone about it. This included his parents and sister.

It was not that Lin fan did not trust his parents and sister. The main thing was that even if he told them, they would not believe him. It would only add to their troubles.

Dai Weixue had also heard that people could become rich overnight by buying stocks and Bitcoin.

Therefore, when she heard Lin Fan’s words, she heaved a sigh of relief in her heart.

Then, she looked at Lin Tao, who was lying in the ward bed with an extremely worried look.

After a moment, she said in a hoarse voice, “I’ll go and pay the fee first.”

Lin Gan said, “Mom, sit and rest. I’ll go.”

The hospital was never short of patients, and there was a long queue at the payment window.

At this moment, a group of doctors in white coats and a few middle-aged men in white shirts who exuded a superior aura walked in together.

Behind them were a few professional reporters with microphones in their hands and video cameras on their shoulders.

The tall and thin man standing beside Lin Fan said in shock, “There’s even a camera! What’s that for?”

The shorter man said, “No way. Didn’t you see the news? The man with the glasses is a big leader in the city!”

“Heavens! A big leader from the city came to visit the hospital? Doesn’t that mean we can also appear on TV today?” The tall, thin man said excitedly.

Lin Fan heard the conversation between the two of them, and his eyes flickered slightly. He walked up with large strides.

The city’s leader was surrounded by guards, and ordinary people could not get close at all.

However, Lin Fan was no ordinary person.

He easily bypassed the guards and came to the leader.

“And you are?” The leader was a little confused.

Lin Fan took out the dragon-shaped token from his pocket and said, “Leader, do you have time to talk in private?”

The pupils of the leader, who was originally calm, shrank slightly.

He had seen the dragon-shaped token once before and was very clear on what it represented. He hurriedly nodded and said, “Of course, you can.”

Then, he turned to the bald doctor and asked, “Director Huang, can you find us a quiet place?”

“Sure, sure. Head this way, please,” Director Huang said.

Soon, Director Huang brought the two of them to a spacious meeting room.

“Director Huang, you should stay too,” Lin Fan said.

“Alright,” Director Huang replied.

The three sat down.

Lin Fan did not beat about the bush and said directly, “I’m actually looking for you this time because I have a personal matter that I need your help with.”

When the leader heard this, not only was he not angry, but he also felt a sense of joy.

Even though Lin Fan’s level was similar to his, the special privileges he had far exceeded his own.

If he could help Lin Fan, he could improve their relationship. In the eyes of the leader, this was definitely a great thing.
